benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench Overall Edit EN (lower better)
benchmarks.config: Figure cell, card comparison table 'minicpm_o_45_main_exp_table.png', Document/OCR/Chart section, row 'OmniDocBench (EN)↓', MiniCPM-o 4.5-Instruct column. Printed value 0.109, recorded verbatim on scale 1: this is an edit-distance ratio, the card prints no % sign, and no x100 conversion is applied. Read by eye from the figure; a second full-table read and a digit-level crop of the cell all returned 0.109. The card's README also carries this same table as HTML text and that cell is 0.109, agreeing exactly, so the +/-0.5 eye-read caveat does not apply to this row. Standing on the row (lower better): PaddleOCR-VL 0.105 is the only better value, so this is second by 0.004 - a near-tie, and the card's 'SOTA for end-to-end English document parsing' claim rests on the 0.105-of-a-pipeline distinction, not a win over PaddleOCR-VL. OverallEdit aggregates TextEdit/FormulaEdit/TableTEDS/TableEdit/ReadOrderEdit; none of those sub-metrics are recorded in this file, so this row double counts nothing. Not comparable to the catalog's OmniDocBench v1.5/v1.6 rows (e.g. minicpm-v-4-6 84.6), which are 0-100 accuracy on a different version with the opposite polarity.

benchmarks.name: OmniDocBench Overall Edit ZH (lower better)
benchmarks.config: Same figure and row group, row 'OmniDocBench (ZH)↓', MiniCPM-o 4.5-Instruct column: 0.162 printed exactly, recorded verbatim on scale 1 (edit-distance ratio, no x100). Three reads agreed - two whole-table reads and a digit-level crop - and the card's README HTML text table prints 0.162 in the same cell. This is the model's weaker OmniDocBench language: on ZH it is mid-field, beaten by HunyuanOCR 0.125, PaddleOCR-VL 0.126, DeepSeek-OCR 2 0.146 and dots.ocr 0.160, level with doubao-1.5-thinking-vision 0.162, and ahead only of MinerU 2.5 0.172 and the general VLMs. So the card's document-parsing claim is an EN-only result; the ZH half of the same row is average. OverallEdit aggregates the five sub-edit metrics, none recorded here, so no double counting.

notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: 36 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 B = 147,456 B/token (144.0 KiB), counting the 36-layer, 4096-hidden text backbone only. All 36 layers are full attention (sliding_window null, use_sliding_window false, max_window_layers 36). The SigLIP vision tower, the Whisper-medium-style audio encoder (32 encoder layers, 1500 mel frames) and the MiniCPMTTS stack are single forward passes or separate small models and add no per-token decoder KV. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. HF card publishes Seed-TTS, MMAU, VoiceBench, LibriSpeech tables; all six rows match. BACKFILLED 2026-11-07: the record carried 27 rows while six of the card's own HTML tables publish 37 more MiniCPM-o 4.5-Instruct values that no pass had ever read - MMT-Bench, MM-IFEval, Mantis-Eval, MuirBench, MMSI-Bench, MotionBench, IFEval-PLS, BBH, CMMLU, MMLU, HumanEval, MBPP, Math500, GSM8K, JointAVBench, AVUT-Human, FutureOmni, Video-MME-Short, LiveSports-3K-CC, LongTTS-en/zh, Expresso, ESD, AISHELL-1/2, WenetSpeech x2, LibriSpeech test-other, GigaSpeech, VoxPopuli, CoVoST x2, Meld, Speech TriviaQA/WebQuestions/CMMLU. All read from the README's HTML text tables, so they are exact cell values, not eye-reads. Two independent parses of the table agreed, header/cell counts align header-by-header, and every one of the 37 was re-verified positionally against its named column; eight (MotionBench 61.4, JointAVBench 60.0, AVUT-Human 78.6, LiveSports 54.4, LongTTS 3.37/6.58, SeedTTS test-en SIM-o 64.9, MMBench EN 87.6) were additionally read off the card's comparison-table image and matched. AUDITED 2026-11-08: re-read the card's main comparison figure (minicpm_o_45_main_exp_table.png) against this file and found one figure row group missing: OmniDocBench Overall Edit EN 0.109 / ZH 0.162. Both are now recorded on scale 1 (edit-distance, lower better). The 2026-11-07 backfill took its 37 rows from the README HTML tables and skipped this pair because it lives in the figure, not in a text table on the same row; the README does carry an OmniDocBench text table and its cells agree exactly with the figure, which is what makes these two exact rather than eye-reads. Nothing else on the figure was missing: all 76 card cells now map to a row except the ten OmniDocBench sub-metric columns (TextEdit/FormulaEdit/TableTEDS/TableEdit/ReadOrderEdit x EN/ZH), which are deliberately not recorded because OverallEdit summarizes them.
